text: Touch support for list (column) editing on mobile
description:
The columns view editing is currently keyboard-only (vim-style); mobile users
with no physical keyboard cannot create/edit/reorder phases or ideas. Add
click/touch affordances that mirror the key actions in
packages/frontend/src/stores/ui/keyboard-actions.ts.

Concrete starting point: tapping an empty phase placeholder/slot in a column
should create a phase (the o/O action).

Phase (column) actions to expose as taps/buttons: create before/after (o/O),
edit (e), delete-with-confirm (d d), mark as current (c), reorder up/down (J/K),
enter idea navigation (i). Column left/right nav (h/l) already has swipe.

Idea navigation actions: create (o/O), edit (e), delete (d d), move out/in the
hierarchy (H/L), reorder up/down (J/K), cut/copy/paste teleport (x/c/p),
show parent paths (s), expand/collapse / step into incoming (h/l).

Graph view: tap to select an idea/link, plus delete (d) and edit (e) affordances.

Global: idea search (/) and view toggle (g) should have visible buttons too.

status.comment:
Touch equivalents exist for every listed action: long-press menus on ideas and phases (create, edit, move, reparent, cut/copy/paste, delete), tap-to-create on empty slots, swipe between columns, Search and Columns/Graph header buttons. Last gap closed in 3822f62: the graph side panel has Edit and Delete (second tap confirms) for the selected idea. Felix still has to try it on a phone (pnpm dev:mobile).

Status reconciliation on 2026-07-30 followed the existing explicit design question rather than guessing a complex touch-editing interaction.
